model_annotation: The figure presents two line plots, each showing the development of the IWF Fiskalindex and the Schuldenuitgavenquote (debt ratio) over time, with data from 1995 to 2020. The left plot displays the IWF Fiskalindex on the left y-axis (ranging from 0 to 2.5) and the Schuldenuitgavenquote Gesamtstaat (total state debt ratio) on the right y-axis (ranging from 60 to 120). The IWF Fiskalindex, represented by a blue line with triangle markers, starts at approximately 0.1 in 1995 and shows a general upward trend, with a significant rise after 2005, peaking near 1.0 around 2010 before declining and then sharply increasing to about 2.0 in 2020. The Schuldenuitgavenquote Gesamtstaat, shown by a magenta line with triangle markers, begins at around 60 in 1995, rises to about 100 by 2010, and then increases more steeply, reaching approximately 110 in 2020. The right plot shows the IWF Fiskalindex on the left y-axis (ranging from -5 to 2.5) and the Schuldenuitgavenquote Zentralstaat (central state debt ratio) on the right y-axis (ranging from 30 to 70). The IWF Fiskalindex, again represented by a blue line with triangle markers, starts at approximately -0.5 in 1995, fluctuates slightly around 0 until 2005, then rises to a peak of about 1.0 in 2010, followed by a decline and a sharp increase to nearly 2.0 in 2020. The Schuldenuitgavenquote Zentralstaat, shown by a magenta line with triangle markers, begins at around 30 in 1995, increases to about 50 by 2010, and then rises sharply to approximately 68 in 2020.
